title: Quick-Fix Middle-Eastern Lamb Shoulder Tagine
description: A smoky, flavorful tagine dish featuring lamb shoulder, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. This recipe is ovo-vegetarian-friendly and features a delicious glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: Rinse the lamb shoulder pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, mix together the olive oil, onions, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper.
Add the lamb shoulder to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a large tagine pot or Dutch oven, and sear over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb broth, water, and labneh to the tagine pot, and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated broiler.
Broil for 20-25 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened into a glassy jelly.
Serve the lamb shoulder hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
